case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests frequently praised the central location and the staff’s friendliness and helpfulness; several noted breakfast as satisfactory. Recurring criticisms include dated or small rooms, uncomfortable/small beds and some bathroom issues (slippery tubs, a non‑working flush, dated fixtures), limited renovated rooms on the top floor, and lack of an elevator with stairs. A few isolated comments mentioned a sagging sofa mattress, dilapidated inner courtyard view, and late‑night guest noise.
